name: 小鴉鵑

iucn.assessmentNote: 全球LC增加；香港漸趨局部

illustrationTaxon: Centropus bengalensis adult breeding plumage; diagnostic head/chest/shoulder shaft-streaking

similarSpecies.distinction: 褐翅鴉鵑體型大得多、尾更長、喙較粗，眼紅，成鳥黑身帶藍紫光且翼亮橙褐；小鴉鵑較小、眼暗，頭胸肩羽有明顯淡色羽軸紋。
雄噪鵑黑亮、紅眼且沒有小鴉鵑的橙褐翼與頭胸淡羽軸紋；噪鵑體型較大、樹棲，小鴉鵑常在草坡或開闊灌叢活動。

featureNotes: 成年繁殖羽頭頸及胸羽有顯著淡色羽軸
肩羽羽軸淡色而明顯，背較褐且較暗淡
翼覆羽與飛羽橙褐，飛羽近端較灰
眼暗，喙較短、較細且上緣較圓

rangeMap.note: Partial native-range overview from India east through Bangladesh and Indochina to southeast China, south through Southeast Asia to the Greater/Lesser Sundas and Philippines. In Hong Kong this species is an increasingly localised resident of grassland, shrubby grassland and open-canopy shrubland; country highlighting is not nationwide occupancy or an exact range polygon.

sources.use: Full HKBWS Lesser Coucal account read: Category I, common but increasingly localised resident in grass-dominated/open-canopy hillside shrub habitats; much declined this century due to succession. Adult 28–34 cm, blackish head/body/tail; orange-brown wing and scapulars; obvious pale shafts on head, chest and scapulars; dark eye, black bill/legs. Global IUCN LC, increasing trend. Range SW/NE India through Bangladesh/Indochina to SE China and south through SE Asia to Sundas/Philippines.

Cornell eBird/Merlin account read: adult dark sturdy coucal with bright chestnut wings and fine silvery streaks on neck/shoulders; significantly smaller than Greater Coucal, dark rather than red eye, duller chestnut and shorter bill. Juveniles have barred tail/underparts. Global IUCN LC.
Full HKBWS Greater Coucal account used for comparator; adult 47–56 cm, larger/longer-tailed with plain glossy blue-black body, orange-brown wing, red-brown eye; widespread common HK resident.
Cornell eBird Greater Coucal comparison account: larger than Lesser Coucal, longer bill, rusty wings and red eyes.
